auth.label: API Key
auth.description: ShortPixel API key used in documented query-string and path-based endpoints. You can find your API key in the ShortPixel dashboard or signup email: https://shortpixel.com/knowledge-base/article/can-i-use-shortpixel-on-a-different-site-and-how-do-i-get-more-credits/.

actions.name: add_domain
actions.description: Add and associate a domain with the current ShortPixel account.

domain.description: The domain name managed in ShortPixel CDN endpoints.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for adding a ShortPixel domain.

code.description: The status code returned by ShortPixel.

message.description: The human-readable status message returned by ShortPixel.

status.description: The status object returned by ShortPixel.

anyOf.description: The domain echoed by ShortPixel when present.

domain.description: The domain echoed by ShortPixel when present.

outputSchema.description: The normalized response returned by ShortPixel domain management actions.
